I'm a full stack engineer and a 2025 Computer Science graduate. I like the whole trip a request takes: the button someone taps, the server code that checks it, and the database row that has to stay correct when two people tap at the same moment.

Right now I build mobile apps in React Native at **Appbrew**, and on the side I'm building **Geeli Maati**, a booking and shop platform for a pottery studio.

Live projects: [Repset](https://repset.in) / [Rachnakaar](https://rachnakaar.vercel.app/) / [Onezy](https://onezy.in) / [Gurukool](https://gurukool.tech)

### Experience

- **Appbrew Technologies**, Associate Software Engineer, Feb 2026 to now. Cross-platform apps on React Native's new Fabric architecture.
- **Braktt Technologies**, frontend intern then SDE intern, Oct 2022 to Jan 2024. Dashboards on REST APIs, a 25% cut in Largest Contentful Paint, and JWT auth flows.

**Teaching.** Ran React workshops for 35+ students at CodeCult, and 20+ sessions for 100+ people as Web Master of Asper Club.

### Projects

**Geeli Maati** (private repo, in progress). Workshop booking, a shop that ships across India, and an admin dashboard in one Next.js app. PostgreSQL transactions and `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` row locks stop the last seat or the last pot from being sold twice, and race-condition tests prove it. Payments run over UPI without a gateway, and emails go out through a transactional outbox with retries.

**[Repset](https://repset.in)**. A gym management SaaS where each gym's data stays its own. Role-based access through Clerk, Razorpay billing, and React Query with optimistic updates for 30% faster interactions.

**[Rachnakaar](https://rachnakaar.vercel.app/)**. A place for Indian writers to publish stories and poems in their own scripts, with a rich text editor and writing competitions.

Also built: [Onezy](https://onezy.in), an agency website, and [Gurukool](https://gurukool.tech), a learning platform that answers questions from your own PDFs.
